package.name: road_numpy_nn_slam
package.description: GRNN: ROS Noetic ground-vehicle (city road autonomous car) assignment. Kinematic bicycle model with understeer in the downtown / campus / construction road networks, traffic lights, pedestrians, parked cars and lane closures; keyboard teleoperation, 360-degree lidar / GNSS / IMU / camera sensors, occupancy-grid SLAM, A* + Stanley navigation, and pure-NumPy neural networks for perception, planning, control and end-to-end camera driving.
